title: Resonance Stone
summary: Carrying this stone gives nearby eligible creatures Steeped in Bliss.

fields.Aura: 30 ft radius around the carrier. Affects allies and enemies except Undead and Constructs.
fields.Steeped in Bliss: Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks. Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves. Vulnerable to Psychic damage.
fields.Acquisition: Mind Flayer Colony near the Mind-Archive Interface, X 692, Y −114.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
